pairs.ask: Two Security Keys On Your Apple ID: Do It Or Not Now?

optionA.label: Do It
optionA.desc: Add a passkey and two Apple Security Keys, then save the recovery key offline. Who does it: You.

optionB.label: Not Now
optionB.desc: Leave it for now. Why it matters: Apple ID also covers Apple Card, and its 2FA status is unknown.

optionA.label: Do It
optionA.desc: Write down the renewal date and check it in the monthly review with the registrar lock. Who does it: You.

visual.svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 240 300" width="240" height="300" style="max-height:100%;max-width:100%"><rect width="240" height="300" rx="14" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#E5E0D8"/><rect x="0" y="0" width="240" height="8" rx="4" fill="#16a34a"/><text x="18" y="30" font-size="9" fill="#525252" font-family="Hind" font-weight="600">SECURITY</text><text x="18" y="58" font-size="17" fill="#0A0A0A" font-family="Khand" font-weight="700">Do It</text><text x="18" y="108" font-size="10.5" fill="#262626" font-family="Hind" font-weight="400">Write down the renewal date and check</text><text x="18" y="123" font-size="10.5" fill="#262626" font-family="Hind" font-weight="400">it in the monthly review with the</text><text x="18" y="138" font-size="10.5" fill="#262626" font-family="Hind" font-weight="400">registrar lock. Who does it: You.</text></svg>

optionB.label: Not Now
optionB.desc: Leave it for now. Why it matters: A missed domain renewal would take the site and its email down.

visual.svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 240 300" width="240" height="300" style="max-height:100%;max-width:100%"><rect width="240" height="300" rx="14" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#E5E0D8"/><rect x="0" y="0" width="240" height="8" rx="4" fill="#A3A3A3"/><text x="18" y="30" font-size="9" fill="#525252" font-family="Hind" font-weight="600">SECURITY</text><text x="18" y="58" font-size="17" fill="#0A0A0A" font-family="Khand" font-weight="700">Not Now</text><text x="18" y="108" font-size="10.5" fill="#262626" font-family="Hind" font-weight="400">Leave it for now. Why it matters: A</text><text x="18" y="123" font-size="10.5" fill="#262626" font-family="Hind" font-weight="400">missed domain renewal would take the</text><text x="18" y="138" font-size="10.5" fill="#262626" font-family="Hind" font-weight="400">site and its email down.</text></svg>

pairs.ask: Consent Checkbox And Terms Link At Checkout: Do It Or Not Now?

optionA.label: Do It
optionA.desc: Legal writes the wording, and UpKeep adds a consent checkbox with a terms link at checkout. Who does it: Legal, Then UpKeep.

visual.svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 240 300" width="240" height="300" style="max-height:100%;max-width:100%"><rect width="240" height="300" rx="14" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#E5E0D8"/><rect x="0" y="0" width="240" height="8" rx="4" fill="#16a34a"/><text x="18" y="30" font-size="9" fill="#525252" font-family="Hind" font-weight="600">SECURITY</text><text x="18" y="58" font-size="17" fill="#0A0A0A" font-family="Khand" font-weight="700">Do It</text><text x="18" y="108" font-size="10.5" fill="#262626" font-family="Hind" font-weight="400">Legal writes the wording, and UpKeep</text><text x="18" y="123" font-size="10.5" fill="#262626" font-family="Hind" font-weight="400">adds a consent checkbox with a terms</text><text x="18" y="138" font-size="10.5" fill="#262626" font-family="Hind" font-weight="400">link at checkout. Who does it: Legal,</text><text x="18" y="153" font-size="10.5" fill="#262626" font-family="Hind" font-weight="400">Then UpKeep.</text></svg>

optionB.label: Not Now
optionB.desc: Leave it for now. Why it matters: There is no consent step or cookie and analytics notice yet.

visual.svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 240 300" width="240" height="300" style="max-height:100%;max-width:100%"><rect width="240" height="300" rx="14" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#E5E0D8"/><rect x="0" y="0" width="240" height="8" rx="4" fill="#A3A3A3"/><text x="18" y="30" font-size="9" fill="#525252" font-family="Hind" font-weight="600">SECURITY</text><text x="18" y="58" font-size="17" fill="#0A0A0A" font-family="Khand" font-weight="700">Not Now</text><text x="18" y="108" font-size="10.5" fill="#262626" font-family="Hind" font-weight="400">Leave it for now. Why it matters:</text><text x="18" y="123" font-size="10.5" fill="#262626" font-family="Hind" font-weight="400">There is no consent step or cookie and</text><text x="18" y="138" font-size="10.5" fill="#262626" font-family="Hind" font-weight="400">analytics notice yet.</text></svg>

pairs.ask: Tenant And Contract Folders Stay Restricted: Do It Or Not Now?

optionA.label: Do It
optionA.desc: The monthly review checks they are still restricted, or in the vault once it exists. Who does it: Security.

visual.svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 240 300" width="240" height="300" style="max-height:100%;max-width:100%"><rect width="240" height="300" rx="14" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#E5E0D8"/><rect x="0" y="0" width="240" height="8" rx="4" fill="#16a34a"/><text x="18" y="30" font-size="9" fill="#525252" font-family="Hind" font-weight="600">SECURITY</text><text x="18" y="58" font-size="17" fill="#0A0A0A" font-family="Khand" font-weight="700">Do It</text><text x="18" y="108" font-size="10.5" fill="#262626" font-family="Hind" font-weight="400">The monthly review checks they are</text><text x="18" y="123" font-size="10.5" fill="#262626" font-family="Hind" font-weight="400">still restricted, or in the vault once</text><text x="18" y="138" font-size="10.5" fill="#262626" font-family="Hind" font-weight="400">it exists. Who does it: Security.</text></svg>

optionB.label: Not Now
optionB.desc: Leave it for now. Why it matters: The tenant and contract folders were restricted today and could be opened up again by mistake.

visual.svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 240 300" width="240" height="300" style="max-height:100%;max-width:100%"><rect width="240" height="300" rx="14" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#E5E0D8"/><rect x="0" y="0" width="240" height="8" rx="4" fill="#A3A3A3"/><text x="18" y="30" font-size="9" fill="#525252" font-family="Hind" font-weight="600">SECURITY</text><text x="18" y="58" font-size="17" fill="#0A0A0A" font-family="Khand" font-weight="700">Not Now</text><text x="18" y="108" font-size="10.5" fill="#262626" font-family="Hind" font-weight="400">Leave it for now. Why it matters: The</text><text x="18" y="123" font-size="10.5" fill="#262626" font-family="Hind" font-weight="400">tenant and contract folders were</text><text x="18" y="138" font-size="10.5" fill="#262626" font-family="Hind" font-weight="400">restricted today and could be opened</text><text x="18" y="153" font-size="10.5" fill="#262626" font-family="Hind" font-weight="400">up again by mistake.</text></svg>

pairs.ask: Second Backup On An Encrypted SSD: Do It Or Not Now?

optionA.label: Do It
optionA.desc: Add an encrypted external SSD as a second copy alongside the cloud backup, refreshed once a month. Who does it: You, With Security.

visual.svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 240 300" width="240" height="300" style="max-height:100%;max-width:100%"><rect width="240" height="300" rx="14" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#E5E0D8"/><rect x="0" y="0" width="240" height="8" rx="4" fill="#16a34a"/><text x="18" y="30" font-size="9" fill="#525252" font-family="Hind" font-weight="600">SECURITY</text><text x="18" y="58" font-size="17" fill="#0A0A0A" font-family="Khand" font-weight="700">Do It</text><text x="18" y="108" font-size="10.5" fill="#262626" font-family="Hind" font-weight="400">Add an encrypted external SSD as a</text><text x="18" y="123" font-size="10.5" fill="#262626" font-family="Hind" font-weight="400">second copy alongside the cloud</text><text x="18" y="138" font-size="10.5" fill="#262626" font-family="Hind" font-weight="400">backup, refreshed once a month. Who</text><text x="18" y="153" font-size="10.5" fill="#262626" font-family="Hind" font-weight="400">does it: You, With Security.</text></svg>

optionB.label: Not Now
optionB.desc: Leave it for now. Why it matters: Two copies in two places means one bad account or one lost bag does not lose everything.

visual.svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 240 300" width="240" height="300" style="max-height:100%;max-width:100%"><rect width="240" height="300" rx="14" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#E5E0D8"/><rect x="0" y="0" width="240" height="8" rx="4" fill="#A3A3A3"/><text x="18" y="30" font-size="9" fill="#525252" font-family="Hind" font-weight="600">SECURITY</text><text x="18" y="58" font-size="17" fill="#0A0A0A" font-family="Khand" font-weight="700">Not Now</text><text x="18" y="108" font-size="10.5" fill="#262626" font-family="Hind" font-weight="400">Leave it for now. Why it matters: Two</text><text x="18" y="123" font-size="10.5" fill="#262626" font-family="Hind" font-weight="400">copies in two places means one bad</text><text x="18" y="138" font-size="10.5" fill="#262626" font-family="Hind" font-weight="400">account or one lost bag does not lose</text><text x="18" y="153" font-size="10.5" fill="#262626" font-family="Hind" font-weight="400">everything.</text></svg>

pairs.ask: First Agent Tokens: Security And UpKeep: Do It Or Not Now?

optionA.label: Do It
optionA.desc: Give the first per-agent tokens to Security and UpKeep, since they push most often, then roll out to the rest. Who does it: Security.

visual.svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 240 300" width="240" height="300" style="max-height:100%;max-width:100%"><rect width="240" height="300" rx="14" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#E5E0D8"/><rect x="0" y="0" width="240" height="8" rx="4" fill="#16a34a"/><text x="18" y="30" font-size="9" fill="#525252" font-family="Hind" font-weight="600">SECURITY</text><text x="18" y="58" font-size="17" fill="#0A0A0A" font-family="Khand" font-weight="700">Do It</text><text x="18" y="108" font-size="10.5" fill="#262626" font-family="Hind" font-weight="400">Give the first per-agent tokens to</text><text x="18" y="123" font-size="10.5" fill="#262626" font-family="Hind" font-weight="400">Security and UpKeep, since they push</text><text x="18" y="138" font-size="10.5" fill="#262626" font-family="Hind" font-weight="400">most often, then roll out to the rest.</text><text x="18" y="153" font-size="10.5" fill="#262626" font-family="Hind" font-weight="400">Who does it: Security.</text></svg>

optionB.label: Not Now
optionB.desc: Leave it for now. Why it matters: Starting where pushes happen most gives the biggest drop in risk for the least setup.

visual.svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 240 300" width="240" height="300" style="max-height:100%;max-width:100%"><rect width="240" height="300" rx="14" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#E5E0D8"/><rect x="0" y="0" width="240" height="8" rx="4" fill="#A3A3A3"/><text x="18" y="30" font-size="9" fill="#525252" font-family="Hind" font-weight="600">SECURITY</text><text x="18" y="58" font-size="17" fill="#0A0A0A" font-family="Khand" font-weight="700">Not Now</text><text x="18" y="108" font-size="10.5" fill="#262626" font-family="Hind" font-weight="400">Leave it for now. Why it matters:</text><text x="18" y="123" font-size="10.5" fill="#262626" font-family="Hind" font-weight="400">Starting where pushes happen most</text><text x="18" y="138" font-size="10.5" fill="#262626" font-family="Hind" font-weight="400">gives the biggest drop in risk for the</text><text x="18" y="153" font-size="10.5" fill="#262626" font-family="Hind" font-weight="400">least setup.</text></svg>

pairs.ask: Reminder Two Weeks Before Each Agent Token Expires: Do It Or Not Now?

optionA.label: Do It
optionA.desc: Security adds every agent token's expiry date to the Morning Report and warns two weeks ahead. Who does it: Security.

visual.svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 240 300" width="240" height="300" style="max-height:100%;max-width:100%"><rect width="240" height="300" rx="14" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#E5E0D8"/><rect x="0" y="0" width="240" height="8" rx="4" fill="#16a34a"/><text x="18" y="30" font-size="9" fill="#525252" font-family="Hind" font-weight="600">SECURITY</text><text x="18" y="58" font-size="17" fill="#0A0A0A" font-family="Khand" font-weight="700">Do It</text><text x="18" y="108" font-size="10.5" fill="#262626" font-family="Hind" font-weight="400">Security adds every agent token's</text><text x="18" y="123" font-size="10.5" fill="#262626" font-family="Hind" font-weight="400">expiry date to the Morning Report and</text><text x="18" y="138" font-size="10.5" fill="#262626" font-family="Hind" font-weight="400">warns two weeks ahead. Who does it:</text><text x="18" y="153" font-size="10.5" fill="#262626" font-family="Hind" font-weight="400">Security.</text></svg>

optionB.label: Not Now
optionB.desc: Leave it for now. Why it matters: 90-day tokens expire on their own. Without a reminder, an agent's pushes would suddenly fail.

visual.svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 240 300" width="240" height="300" style="max-height:100%;max-width:100%"><rect width="240" height="300" rx="14" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#E5E0D8"/><rect x="0" y="0" width="240" height="8" rx="4" fill="#A3A3A3"/><text x="18" y="30" font-size="9" fill="#525252" font-family="Hind" font-weight="600">SECURITY</text><text x="18" y="58" font-size="17" fill="#0A0A0A" font-family="Khand" font-weight="700">Not Now</text><text x="18" y="108" font-size="10.5" fill="#262626" font-family="Hind" font-weight="400">Leave it for now. Why it matters:</text><text x="18" y="123" font-size="10.5" fill="#262626" font-family="Hind" font-weight="400">90-day tokens expire on their own.</text><text x="18" y="138" font-size="10.5" fill="#262626" font-family="Hind" font-weight="400">Without a reminder, an agent's pushes</text><text x="18" y="153" font-size="10.5" fill="#262626" font-family="Hind" font-weight="400">would suddenly fail.</text></svg>

pairs.ask: Offline List Of Key Accounts On Your Phone: Do It Or Not Now?

optionA.label: Do It
optionA.desc: Keep a short offline list on your phone of key accounts, their recovery emails and support numbers, with no passwords. Who does it: You, With Security.

visual.svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 240 300" width="240" height="300" style="max-height:100%;max-width:100%"><rect width="240" height="300" rx="14" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#E5E0D8"/><rect x="0" y="0" width="240" height="8" rx="4" fill="#16a34a"/><text x="18" y="30" font-size="9" fill="#525252" font-family="Hind" font-weight="600">SECURITY</text><text x="18" y="58" font-size="17" fill="#0A0A0A" font-family="Khand" font-weight="700">Do It</text><text x="18" y="108" font-size="10.5" fill="#262626" font-family="Hind" font-weight="400">Keep a short offline list on your</text><text x="18" y="123" font-size="10.5" fill="#262626" font-family="Hind" font-weight="400">phone of key accounts, their recovery</text><text x="18" y="138" font-size="10.5" fill="#262626" font-family="Hind" font-weight="400">emails and support numbers, with no</text><text x="18" y="153" font-size="10.5" fill="#262626" font-family="Hind" font-weight="400">passwords. Who does it: You, With</text><text x="18" y="168" font-size="10.5" fill="#262626" font-family="Hind" font-weight="400">Security.</text></svg>

optionB.label: Not Now
optionB.desc: Leave it for now. Why it matters: If a phone or account is lost while traveling, you can start recovery without being online.

visual.svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 240 300" width="240" height="300" style="max-height:100%;max-width:100%"><rect width="240" height="300" rx="14" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#E5E0D8"/><rect x="0" y="0" width="240" height="8" rx="4" fill="#A3A3A3"/><text x="18" y="30" font-size="9" fill="#525252" font-family="Hind" font-weight="600">SECURITY</text><text x="18" y="58" font-size="17" fill="#0A0A0A" font-family="Khand" font-weight="700">Not Now</text><text x="18" y="108" font-size="10.5" fill="#262626" font-family="Hind" font-weight="400">Leave it for now. Why it matters: If a</text><text x="18" y="123" font-size="10.5" fill="#262626" font-family="Hind" font-weight="400">phone or account is lost while</text><text x="18" y="138" font-size="10.5" fill="#262626" font-family="Hind" font-weight="400">traveling, you can start recovery</text><text x="18" y="153" font-size="10.5" fill="#262626" font-family="Hind" font-weight="400">without being online.</text></svg>

pairs.ask: Move The Box's Saved Page Password Into 1Password Later: Do It Or Not Now?

optionA.label: Do It
optionA.desc: Once 1Password works for agents, move the page password from the private file on the shared computer into the Agents vault. Who does it: Security.

visual.svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 240 300" width="240" height="300" style="max-height:100%;max-width:100%"><rect width="240" height="300" rx="14" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#E5E0D8"/><rect x="0" y="0" width="240" height="8" rx="4" fill="#16a34a"/><text x="18" y="30" font-size="9" fill="#525252" font-family="Hind" font-weight="600">SECURITY</text><text x="18" y="58" font-size="17" fill="#0A0A0A" font-family="Khand" font-weight="700">Do It</text><text x="18" y="108" font-size="10.5" fill="#262626" font-family="Hind" font-weight="400">Once 1Password works for agents, move</text><text x="18" y="123" font-size="10.5" fill="#262626" font-family="Hind" font-weight="400">the page password from the private</text><text x="18" y="138" font-size="10.5" fill="#262626" font-family="Hind" font-weight="400">file on the shared computer into the</text><text x="18" y="153" font-size="10.5" fill="#262626" font-family="Hind" font-weight="400">Agents vault. Who does it: Security.</text></svg>

optionB.label: Not Now
optionB.desc: Leave it for now. Why it matters: Today the lock tools read it from a private file on the shared computer. A vault is easier to rotate.

visual.svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 240 300" width="240" height="300" style="max-height:100%;max-width:100%"><rect width="240" height="300" rx="14" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#E5E0D8"/><rect x="0" y="0" width="240" height="8" rx="4" fill="#A3A3A3"/><text x="18" y="30" font-size="9" fill="#525252" font-family="Hind" font-weight="600">SECURITY</text><text x="18" y="58" font-size="17" fill="#0A0A0A" font-family="Khand" font-weight="700">Not Now</text><text x="18" y="108" font-size="10.5" fill="#262626" font-family="Hind" font-weight="400">Leave it for now. Why it matters:</text><text x="18" y="123" font-size="10.5" fill="#262626" font-family="Hind" font-weight="400">Today the lock tools read it from a</text><text x="18" y="138" font-size="10.5" fill="#262626" font-family="Hind" font-weight="400">private file on the shared computer. A</text><text x="18" y="153" font-size="10.5" fill="#262626" font-family="Hind" font-weight="400">vault is easier to rotate.</text></svg>

pairs.ask: Clear Out Old Unlocked Copies On The Shared Computer: Do It Or Not Now?

optionA.label: Do It
optionA.desc: Delete leftover test copies on the shared computer (old walk-app and deck copies) that still hold unlocked pages. Who does it: Security, With Your OK.

visual.svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 240 300" width="240" height="300" style="max-height:100%;max-width:100%"><rect width="240" height="300" rx="14" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#E5E0D8"/><rect x="0" y="0" width="240" height="8" rx="4" fill="#16a34a"/><text x="18" y="30" font-size="9" fill="#525252" font-family="Hind" font-weight="600">SECURITY</text><text x="18" y="58" font-size="17" fill="#0A0A0A" font-family="Khand" font-weight="700">Do It</text><text x="18" y="108" font-size="10.5" fill="#262626" font-family="Hind" font-weight="400">Delete leftover test copies on the</text><text x="18" y="123" font-size="10.5" fill="#262626" font-family="Hind" font-weight="400">shared computer (old walk-app and deck</text><text x="18" y="138" font-size="10.5" fill="#262626" font-family="Hind" font-weight="400">copies) that still hold unlocked</text><text x="18" y="153" font-size="10.5" fill="#262626" font-family="Hind" font-weight="400">pages. Who does it: Security, With</text><text x="18" y="168" font-size="10.5" fill="#262626" font-family="Hind" font-weight="400">Your OK.</text></svg>

optionB.label: Not Now
optionB.desc: Leave it for now. Why it matters: Old copies hold the unlocked text and the customer address, and any agent can read them.

visual.svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 240 300" width="240" height="300" style="max-height:100%;max-width:100%"><rect width="240" height="300" rx="14" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#E5E0D8"/><rect x="0" y="0" width="240" height="8" rx="4" fill="#A3A3A3"/><text x="18" y="30" font-size="9" fill="#525252" font-family="Hind" font-weight="600">SECURITY</text><text x="18" y="58" font-size="17" fill="#0A0A0A" font-family="Khand" font-weight="700">Not Now</text><text x="18" y="108" font-size="10.5" fill="#262626" font-family="Hind" font-weight="400">Leave it for now. Why it matters: Old</text><text x="18" y="123" font-size="10.5" fill="#262626" font-family="Hind" font-weight="400">copies hold the unlocked text and the</text><text x="18" y="138" font-size="10.5" fill="#262626" font-family="Hind" font-weight="400">customer address, and any agent can</text><text x="18" y="153" font-size="10.5" fill="#262626" font-family="Hind" font-weight="400">read them.</text></svg>

pairs.ask: Log Who Unlocks Pages On The Shared Computer: Do It Or Not Now?

optionA.label: Do It
optionA.desc: Each time an agent runs the unlock tool, add one line (agent, site, time) to a log that Security reviews weekly. Who does it: Security.

optionB.label: Not Now
optionB.desc: Leave it for now. Why it matters: Agents can now unlock pages to edit them. A log shows who did it if something leaks.
